drop.reason: Introduces the HOMER motif-finding tool; cited overwhelmingly as a software/method reference rather than a genome-regulation mechanism finding.
TCGA integrated cancer genomics of endometrial carcinoma; methylation is one clinical readout, genome-regulation mechanism incidental.
GREAT is a software tool for annotating cis-regulatory regions; result is a tool, not a finding.
Proteome-wide lysine acetylation (acetylome) by mass spec; not a chromatin/genome-regulation mechanism.
Autism exome/disease-gene study; off-field, chromatin genes only incidental.
Near-duplicate lincRNA-chromatin paper; HOTAIR (r11) and the lincRNA chromatin-signature paper (r14) already cover this.
Epigenetic drift between monozygotic twins; an observation of epigenetic variation, not a genome-regulation mechanism.
Methylation as a readout in a behavioral/clinical association (childhood abuse); mechanism incidental, off-field.
ESC transcription-factor network ChIP-seq map; TF-network focus rather than a chromatin/epigenetic mechanism.
Tissue-resident macrophage enhancer landscapes; more immunology, and the enhancer milestone is already well covered by higher-cited papers.
Sorghum genome-sequencing paper; off-field, not genome regulation.
Combinatorial histone acetylation/methylation patterns; incremental to the histone-mark genome maps already kept.
Sporadic autism exome study; off-field disease genetics.
Transgenerational endocrine-disruptor toxicology; epigenetic mechanism asserted but phenotype-driven and incidental.
HOTTIP lncRNA; near-duplicate of the lncRNA-chromatin papers already kept.
Autoimmune GWAS fine-mapping; chromatin used only as annotation, disease-variant focus off-field.
Promoter chromatin landmark / transcription-initiation survey; incremental to the chromatin-state and histone-mark maps kept.
CpG island methylator phenotype in colorectal cancer; methylation as a clinical tumour trait, mechanism incidental.
Catalog of 67 histone marks (incl. crotonylation); a mark-discovery catalog, redundant with the histone-mark maps kept.
CRISPR-dCas9-p300 epigenome-editing technology; result is a tool/method, not a finding.
Enhancer-like lncRNAs; near-duplicate of the lncRNA-chromatin papers already kept.
BCG trained immunity in monocytes; immunology, epigenetic reprogramming only as a readout.
Chromatin-architecture reorganization during differentiation; incremental to the Hi-C/TAD papers kept.
p300 ChIP-seq enhancer prediction; enhancer milestone already covered by more foundational, higher-cited papers.
Spermidine/autophagy/longevity; off-field, not genome regulation.
Hippocampal chromatin in a depression/antidepressant model; behavioral/clinical, off-field.
PAD4 and neutrophil extracellular traps; innate-immunity chromatin decondensation, not genome regulation.
Arabidopsis DNA-methylation map; near-duplicate of the base-resolution Arabidopsis methylome kept (pmid:18278030).
Circadian-clock chromatin landscape; system-specific, not a foundational mechanism milestone.
5C long-range promoter-interaction landscape; incremental to the Hi-C/TAD/loop-extrusion papers kept.

notes: The kept 30 are pre-2016 primary classics spread across the milestones: 3D genome (first Hi-C, the Xic/TAD paper, lamina-associated domains, loop extrusion, and pathogenic TAD disruption), ENCODE functional elements and the genome-wide DNase accessibility map, histone-mark and chromatin-state maps (Barski, Mikkelsen, Roadmap 111 epigenomes), the histone-demethylase (JmjC eraser) mechanism, Polycomb/PRC2 targets and bivalent domains plus the EZH2-DNA-methylation link, DNA methylation/demethylation (TET 5mC->5hmC, human promoter methylation, base-resolution plant methylome, brain non-CG methylome, intragenic methylation), X-inactivation (Xic partitioning and RepA/PRC2 recruitment), foundational enhancer biology (first promoter/enhancer signatures, H3K27ac active vs poised, super-enhancers, eRNAs, cell-type-specific and poised developmental enhancers), lncRNA-directed chromatin regulation (HOTAIR, lincRNA chromatin signatures), and epigenetic reprogramming (iPSCs). Dropped: tool/resource papers (HOMER, GREAT, dCas9-p300 editing), consortium cancer/GWAS and disease/behavioral studies where chromatin is only a readout, off-field genome/physiology papers, proteome-wide acetylation, and near-duplicate lincRNA, histone-catalog and 3D-interaction papers. Main gap: genomic imprinting has no strong dedicated primary paper in the shortlist, so that milestone is under-represented; enhancer biology is the most heavily represented subfield, matching its weight in the shortlist.
